info.title: Swissdec Quality Tool API
info.description:
Authentication

This API requires an API key passed as a Bearer token in the Authorization header:

Authorization: Bearer <your-api-key>

You can obtain your API key in your profile menu at https://test.swissdec.ch/api-key-qt.xhtml

Usage Examples

Example for automized ELM Tests (V6)

  1. Reset and load desired references through API (POST /elm/v6/runs/{monitoringId}/current/reset/{lang})
  2. Assert the score is zero with provided report from Step 1
  3. Transmit data to the SalaryDeclarationService
  4. Get and assert the desired score through API (GET /elm/v6/runs/{monitoringId}/current/report)
  5. Archive run if desired (POST /elm/v6/runs/{monitoringId}/current/archive)
  6. For another run, or different references, start again with Step 1

If you wish to keep your current references, you can do so by only resetting your requests (DELETE /elm/v6/runs/{monitoringId}/current/requests)
